title: Forgot password page: read features.emailDelivery and say a reset link cannot be emailed here (ask an administrator) instead of saying it was sent
body:
domain:server#2 · os-bill · session_01Utp6Cbvcmv8YWFhFJwzjKL

Filing gate: ② the ui half of #30107, named by its dev (PR #30365, os-dev-report 6652972753, out_of_scope, carrier domain:ui). ⛔ Not a claim. Triage sets lane and grade.
Reader: `ui/packages/auth/src/ForgotPasswordForm.tsx`, `ui/packages/i18n` (`successDescription`, every locale).
Dedupe: `forgot password emailDelivery` → none open. **New.**

## What is missing

After PR #30365, `GET /api/v1/auth/config` answers `features.emailDelivery`: `true` only when the wired email service is configured; `false` with no email service or the stock `log` transport. The forgot-password form still shows 「我们已将密码重置链接发送至 …，请检查您的收件箱。」 (and "Check your email" in English) on a deployment that sends no mail.

## Wanted

- [ ] When `features.emailDelivery` is not `true`, the form (or its success screen) says a reset link cannot be emailed on this deployment and to ask an administrator, who can set a password from Setup → Users.
- [ ] The text is about the deployment, not the address: a known and an unknown address read the same (the no-account-existence-oracle rule at `ForgotPasswordForm.tsx` ~:221 holds).
- [ ] Every locale.

Links: #30107, PR #30365.
